title: Ender's Bench site
description: Set what visitors may run. Keys are stored encrypted and never reach the browser. Start this Actor with a long timeout: its container URL is the site's address for as long as the run lasts.

models.title: Models on offer
models.description: The Run button offers only these. Each entry: id, label, provider (script, anthropic, openai, openrouter or custom), model, and for custom an optional baseUrl and effort. Every run spends your keys, so keep the list short.

caseSets.title: Case sets on offer
caseSets.description: Any of quick (7 cases), held-out (25) and all (70).

maxRunsPerHour.title: Runs per hour
maxRunsPerHour.description: The site starts one run at a time and at most this many per hour.

anthropicApiKey.title: Anthropic API key
anthropicApiKey.description: Needed for any anthropic model in the list.

openaiApiKey.title: OpenAI API key
openaiApiKey.description: Needed for any openai model in the list.

openrouterApiKey.title: OpenRouter API key
openrouterApiKey.description: Needed for any openrouter model in the list.

customBaseUrl.title: Custom endpoint base URL
customBaseUrl.description: The OpenAI-compatible API for custom models without their own baseUrl, for example our fine-tune on RunPod. Kept secret so the endpoint isn't published.

customApiKey.title: Custom endpoint API key
customApiKey.description: Sent to the custom endpoint, if it needs one.

crsLive.title: Use the live CRS sandbox
crsLive.description: Runs started here send each CRS check to the sandbox with the login below. Off: the saved Oct 24 responses.

benchActor.title: Benchmark Actor
benchActor.description: Which Actor the Run button starts, as username/actor-name. Empty means your own enders-bench.
